text_en: Then the Lord said to Noah, “Go into the ark, you and all your household, for I have seen that you alone are righteous before me in this generation.
text_cn: 上主对诺厄说：“你和你全家进入方舟，因为在这一世代，我看只有你在我面前正义。

text_en: Take with you seven pairs of all clean animals, the male and its mate; and a pair of the animals that are not clean, the male and its mate;
text_cn: 由一切洁净牲畜中，各取公母七对；由那些不洁净的牲畜中，各取公母一对；

text_en: and seven pairs of the birds of the air also, male and female, to keep their kind alive on the face of all the earth.
text_cn: 由天空的飞鸟中，也各取公母七对；好在全地面上传种。

text_en: For in seven days I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights; and every living thing that I have made I will blot out from the face of the ground. ”
text_cn: 因为还有七天，我要在地上降雨四十天四十夜，消灭我在地面上所造的一切生物。”

text_en: And Noah did all that the Lord had commanded him.
text_cn: 诺厄全照上主吩咐他的做了。

text_en: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.
text_cn: 当洪水在地上泛滥时，诺厄已六百岁。

text_en: And Noah with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives went into the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
text_cn: 诺厄和他的儿子，他的妻子和他的儿媳，同他进了方舟，为躲避洪水。

text_en: Of clean animals, and of animals that are not clean, and of birds, and of everything that creeps on the ground,
text_cn: 洁净的牲畜和不洁净的牲畜，飞鸟和各种在地上爬行的动物，

text_en: two and two, male and female, went into the ark with Noah, as God had commanded Noah.
text_cn: 一对一对地同诺厄进了方舟；都是一公一母，照天主对他所吩咐的。

text_en: And after seven days the waters of the flood came on the earth.
text_cn: 七天一过，洪水就在地上泛滥。

text_en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the windows of the heavens were opened.
text_cn: 诺厄六百岁那一年，二月十七日那天，所有深渊的泉水都冒出，天上的水闸都开放了；

text_en: The rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.
text_cn: 大雨在地上下了四十天四十夜。

text_en: On the very same day Noah with his sons, Shem and Ham and Japheth, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons entered the ark,
text_cn: 正在这一天，诺厄和他的儿子闪、含、耶斐特，他的妻子和他的三个儿媳，一同进了方舟。

text_en: they and every wild animal of every kind, and all domestic animals of every kind, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every bird of every kind—every bird, every winged creature.
text_cn: 他们八口和所有的野兽、各种牲畜、各种在地上爬行的爬虫、各种飞禽，

text_en: They went into the ark with Noah, two and two of all flesh in which there was the breath of life.
text_cn: 一切有生气有血肉的，都一对一对地同诺厄进了方舟。

text_en: And those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him; and the Lord shut him in.
text_cn: 凡有血肉的，都是一公一母地进了方舟，如天主对诺厄所吩咐的。随后上主关了门。

text_en: The flood continued forty days on the earth; and the waters increased, and bore up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.
text_cn: 洪水在地上泛滥了四十天；水不断增涨，浮起了方舟，方舟遂由地面上升起。

text_en: The waters swelled and increased greatly on the earth; and the ark floated on the face of the waters.
text_cn: 洪水汹涌，在地上猛涨，方舟漂浮在水面上。

text_en: The waters swelled so mightily on the earth that all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered;
text_cn: 洪水在地上一再猛涨，天下所有的高山也都没了顶；

text_en: the waters swelled above the mountains, covering them fifteen cubits deep.
text_cn: 洪水高出淹没的群山十有五肘。

text_en: And all flesh died that moved on the earth, birds, domestic animals, wild animals, all swarming creatures that swarm on the earth, and all human beings;
text_cn: 凡地上行动而有血肉的生物：飞禽、牲畜、野兽，在地上爬行的爬虫，以及所有的人全灭亡了；

text_en: everything on dry land in whose nostrils was the breath of life died.
text_cn: 凡在旱地上以鼻呼吸的生灵都死了。

text_en: He blotted out every living thing that was on the face of the ground, human beings and animals and creeping things and birds of the air; they were blotted out from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those that were with him in the ark.
text_cn: 这样，天主消灭了在地面上的一切生物，由人以至于牲畜、爬虫以及天空中的飞鸟，这一切都由地上消灭了，只剩下诺厄和同他在方舟内的人物。

text_en: And the waters swelled on the earth for one hundred fifty days.
text_cn: 洪水在地上泛滥了一百五十天。
